categories.installedF03F04: all source, migrations, checks, inventories and notices; excludes reproducible node_modules

retainedFailures: Initial local contract capture put its changing output inside the candidate tree. All 12 tests passed but final candidate integrity guard failed. Capture corrected to external temporary files; both complete streams retained.

Controller pre-fix staging: three new groups fail because old adapter accepts no-op confirmation, changed postdecrypt confirmation and no-op publication; full raw streams and cleanup retained. Strengthened after-hook stage case now changes actual confirmation instead of throwing.
limitations: New publication mutations and GC post-effect wait use the existing admin-only diagnostic PG owner. This is not authenticated canonical save/command settlement or user serving.

File adapter observes callback postconditions before same-transaction COMMIT; installed owner still must validate current identity/source/audience/material and original command after waits and effects through completion.

Typed lost acknowledgements retain UNKNOWN_COMMIT and no replay. No distributed FS/PG atomicity or hostile filesystem custody, hardware power-loss, complete memory zeroization or disaster recovery is claimed.

Authenticated canonical publication/settled content command, full every-class encryption scan, useful saved-decision Ask, retention/delete propagation, actual encrypted content-loss restore and aggregate/independent acceptance remain pending.

All X01-X09 and real KMS/rotation/provider/remote/hardware/multi-host/enterprise-hold environments remain unqualified. Current PG/witness/material authority, independent ephemeral keys and trusted single-host custody remain required.
